subject: Mythology
title: The Bhagavad Gita: Song of God
description: A fast breakdown of The Bhagavad Gita: Song of God for builders.

hook.text: On a battlefield with millions of soldiers, Arjuna refused to fight because his enemies were his own family.

buildup.text: Krishna, his charioteer, asked him a devastating question: what is more important — love or duty?

discovery.text: Krishna taught that action without attachment to results is the highest spiritual path a person can follow.

twist.text: He revealed his cosmic form — infinite, terrifying, and beautiful — showing Arjuna that death is only an illusion.

climax.text: The Gita became the most translated and quoted Hindu text, influencing Gandhi, Oppenheimer, and Emerson.

punchline.text: The most profound conversation in history happened on a battlefield.

quiz.question: What was Krishna's core teaching in the Bhagavad Gita?
options: Violence is always wrong, regardless of the cause
Action without attachment to results is the highest path
Meditation alone can solve all human problems
